data.purpose: Numbers, ids, chart text. Never headings or prose.

motion.name: untilt
motion.value: animation-name: untilt; animation-timing-function: linear; animation-fill-mode: both; (separate selector .tilt.tilt) animation-timeline: view(); animation-range: entry 0% cover 42%
motion.purpose: The one authored motion. Gate: @supports (animation-timeline: view()) and (min-width: 900px) and (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference). Timeline longhand lives in its own selector; minifiers break the shorthand.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Light gradient button with a faint iridescent rim.

narrative.overview: A research journal that behaves like a quiet instrument panel, in graphite.com grammar: near-black ground, alpha-stepped off-white ink, 1px low-alpha rules, bezelled product frames, glowing line art. Night mode only. Honesty labels are first-class components.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome world; only desaturated long, short and amber hues.
Structure from 1px alpha rules and inset rings.
Geist for words, Geist Mono for numbers and data only.
One authored motion, on the home page only.

rules.name: The Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Long and short colours never carry meaning alone; always a sign, glyph or word.

rules.name: The Alpha-Step Rule
rules.body: Secondary text and hairlines are the same white at lower alpha, not new greys.

rules.name: The Rare Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber flags illustration or caution only.

rules.name: The Mono-For-Numbers Rule
rules.body: Mono is for numbers, ids, dates in data and code only.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase kickers above headings.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is a white glow or brighter ring, never a coloured shadow.

dos: Do keep night mode only on #070707 with ink #f9f9f9 and alpha steps for secondary text.
Do build edges from 1px alpha rules or inset rings.
Do pair long and short with a sign, glyph or word every time.
Do use Geist Mono with tabular numerals for numbers only.
Do attach the amber 'Illustrative prices, not real market data' label to charts with invented prices.
Do show in-sample, best of N and slippage scenario labels beside the numbers they qualify.
donts: Don't use mono for headings, buttons or prose.
Don't make grids of identical cards.
Don't let long or short colour be the only signal.
Don't add a second authored motion or run the untilt below 900px or under reduced motion.
